source.title: Giuseppe Pitrè, Feste patronali in Sicilia (1900)

method: Original 1900 PDF pages were rendered and all 237 individually cropped source regions were included in 20 contact sheets (9 Wave04 sheets and 11 Wave05 sheets). Reviewer inspected the displayed sheet images. This is image-region visibility review combined with exact normalized PDF text-word matching; it is not independent OCR, full-page line-by-line examination, full-folio image certification, independent historical corroboration or ritual approval. In Wave05 three originally captured anchors needed shorter exact rematching owing to punctuation/header OCR contamination. Per-record source metadata and corrections below are reproducible using the referenced scan, SHA-256 and locator.
caveat: Existing Wave04 105-pending image-review queue and Wave05 staging represent their dated original snapshots. This addendum records later preview inspection; it does not silently flip their full-image-certification flags and does not qualify observations for public Calendar publication.

source_contact_sheets.location: Reproducible locally from source PDF; image proof generated during research and not committed to GitHub to avoid storage costs.
